long_biography.plain_text:
Opening Romania's first Pizza Hut in 1994 made Radu Dimofte one of the country's early international restaurant-franchise builders. After returning from the United States, he worked with longtime associates Lucian Vlad and Nicolae Badea to add KFC. They developed a multi-brand food-service network in a market with few global chains.

Dimofte combined the principal restaurant companies within Sphera Franchise Group and became its largest ultimate beneficial owner. The reorganisation placed regional Pizza Hut, KFC and Taco Bell businesses under a listed parent managed by professional executives. Businesses inherited from his father, Zerlin Dimofte, remained another material responsibility. That family portfolio came to include Bucharest commercial property and branded hotels.
